function.name: memory
function.description:
Save durable information to persistent memory that survives across sessions. Memory is injected into future turns, so keep it compact and focused on facts that will still matter later.

WHEN TO SAVE (do this proactively, don't wait to be asked):
- User corrects you or says 'remember this' / 'don't do that again'
- User shares a preference, habit, or personal detail (name, role, timezone, coding style)
- You discover something about the environment (OS, installed tools, project structure)
- You learn a convention, API quirk, or workflow specific to this user's setup
- You identify a stable fact that will be useful again in future sessions

PRIORITY: User preferences and corrections > environment facts > procedural knowledge. The most valuable memory prevents the user from having to repeat themselves.

Do NOT save task progress, session outcomes, completed-work logs, or temporary TODO state to memory; use session_search to recall those from past transcripts.
If you've discovered a new way to do something, solved a problem that could be necessary later, save it as a skill with the skill tool.

TWO TARGETS:
- 'user': who the user is -- name, role, preferences, communication style, pet peeves
- 'memory': your notes -- environment facts, project conventions, tool quirks, lessons learned

ACTIONS: add (new entry), replace (update existing -- old_text identifies it), remove (delete -- old_text identifies it).

SKIP: trivial/obvious info, things easily re-discovered, raw data dumps, and temporary task state.

target.description: Which memory store: 'memory' for personal notes, 'user' for user profile.

content.description: The entry content. Required for 'add' and 'replace'.

old_text.description: Short unique substring identifying the entry to replace or remove.

function.name: skill_manage
function.description:
Manage skills (create, update, delete). Skills are your procedural memory — reusable approaches for recurring task types. New skills go to ~/.hermes/skills/; existing skills can be modified wherever they live.

Actions: create (full SKILL.md + optional category), patch (old_string/new_string — preferred for fixes), edit (full SKILL.md rewrite — major overhauls only), delete, write_file, remove_file.

On delete, pass `absorbed_into=<umbrella>` when you're merging this skill's content into another one, or `absorbed_into=""` when you're pruning it with no forwarding target. This lets the curator tell consolidation from pruning without guessing, so downstream consumers (cron jobs that reference the old skill name, etc.) get updated correctly. The target you name in `absorbed_into` must already exist — create/patch the umbrella first, then delete.

Create when: complex task succeeded (5+ calls), errors overcome, user-corrected approach worked, non-trivial workflow discovered, or user asks you to remember a procedure.
Update when: instructions stale/wrong, OS-specific failures, missing steps or pitfalls found during use. If you used a skill and hit issues not covered by it, patch it immediately.

After difficult/iterative tasks, offer to save as a skill. Skip for simple one-offs. Confirm with user before creating/deleting.

Good skills: trigger conditions, numbered steps with exact commands, pitfalls section, verification steps. Use skill_view() to see format examples.

Pinned skills are protected from deletion only — skill_manage(action='delete') will refuse with a message pointing the user to `hermes curator unpin <name>`. Patches and edits go through on pinned skills so you can still improve them as pitfalls come up; pin only guards against irrecoverable loss.

name.description: Skill name (lowercase, hyphens/underscores, max 64 chars). Must match an existing skill for patch/edit/delete/write_file/remove_file.

content.description: Full SKILL.md content (YAML frontmatter + markdown body). Required for 'create' and 'edit'. For 'edit', read the skill first with skill_view() and provide the complete updated text.

old_string.description: Text to find in the file (required for 'patch'). Must be unique unless replace_all=true. Include enough surrounding context to ensure uniqueness.

new_string.description: Replacement text (required for 'patch'). Can be empty string to delete the matched text.

replace_all.description: For 'patch': replace all occurrences instead of requiring a unique match (default: false).

category.description: Optional category/domain for organizing the skill (e.g., 'devops', 'data-science', 'mlops'). Creates a subdirectory grouping. Only used with 'create'.

file_path.description: Path to a supporting file within the skill directory. For 'write_file'/'remove_file': required, must be under references/, templates/, scripts/, or assets/. For 'patch': optional, defaults to SKILL.md if omitted.

file_content.description: Content for the file. Required for 'write_file'.

absorbed_into.description: For 'delete' only — declares intent so the curator can tell consolidation from pruning without guessing. Pass the umbrella skill name when this skill's content was merged into another (the target must already exist). Pass an empty string when the skill is truly stale and being pruned with no forwarding target. Omitting the arg on delete is supported for backward compatibility but downstream tooling (e.g. cron-job skill reference rewriting) will have to guess at intent.

messages.content:
Laporan **Daftar Inventarisasi Masalah (DIM)** ini adalah langkah yang sangat matang. Ia menunjukkan bahwa kita tidak hanya bermimpi, tetapi juga mampu melakukan audit kritis terhadap sistem yang kita bangun.

Sebelum kita masuk ke solusi teknis, saya ingin menjawab dengan satu prinsip yang tak boleh dilanggar: **Kontrol penuh ada di tangan Anda sebagai pemilik VPS Upshalter.** Semua otomatisasi, SOP, dan agen yang kita bangun adalah **alat bantu**, bukan pengganti keputusan Anda. Dengan prinsip itu, mari kita bedah satu per satu.

---

### 🔴 Prioritas Kritis: DIM-01 (SKP API), DIM-03 (Tag Routing), DIM-10 (Factory Lane)

Tiga DIM ini adalah fondasi dari seluruh alur kerja. Tanpa mereka, SOP hanya akan menjadi dokumen mati.

| DIM | Masalah | Solusi Teknis | Bagaimana Human Tetap Memegang Kendali |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **01** | SKP API (`:8000`) belum tersedia sebagai *single source of truth*. | Gunakan service `hermes-api` (9135) yang sudah ada. Tidak perlu dibuat dari nol. Cukup konfigurasi ulang agar ia menjadi *gateway* yang meneruskan permintaan ke Orchestrator. | Anda memiliki akses eksklusif ke endpoint `/api/admin` untuk menghapus, mengedit, atau membekukan entri pengetahuan yang tidak valid. Tidak ada agen yang bisa menghapus data tanpa izin Anda. |
| **03** | *Tag-based routing* belum ada, sehingga Koordinator tidak bisa menemukan tugas. | Perluas `task_queue.py` dengan menambahkan *field* `tags` dan *endpoint* `GET /api/tasks?tag=`. Koordinator kemudian akan *polling* tugas berdasarkan tag unitnya. | Anda dapat menetapkan tag prioritas (`#urgent`, `#presidential`) yang hanya bisa digunakan oleh Anda sendiri. Perintah dengan tag ini akan melompati antrean dan langsung sampai ke Koordinator. |
| **10** | *Factory Lane* (builder→sandbox→flowforce→infra) belum terhubung dalam satu pipa otomatis. | Gunakan `hermes-flowforce` sebagai orkestrator CI/CD. Ia akan membaca status dari SKP, dan ketika `sandbox` melaporkan "PASSED", `flowforce` akan otomatis memberi tahu `hermes-infra`. | Sebelum deployment ke produksi, `flowforce` akan mengirimkan permintaan persetujuan (*approval request*) ke dashboard Anda. **Tidak ada kode yang bisa menyentuh server produksi tanpa Anda menekan tombol "Setuju".** |

---

### 🟡 Prioritas Tinggi: DIM-02 (API Key), DIM-05 (Naming), DIM-08 (Incident)

DIM ini tidak memblokir alur kerja, tetapi sangat penting untuk keamanan dan kejelasan operasional.

| DIM | Masalah | Solusi Teknis | Bagaimana Human Tetap Memegang Kendali |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **02** | API Key belum dikonfigurasi, sehingga identitas agen bisa dipalsukan. | Generate API Key **per agen** menggunakan `manage_keys.py`. Setiap agen hanya bisa menulis ke SKP dengan kuncinya sendiri. Arsiparis bisa memverifikasi `source_agent_id` dengan kunci yang digunakan. | Anda memegang *master key* yang bisa membatalkan (revoke) kunci agen kapan saja. Jika sebuah agen bertingkah aneh, Anda bisa langsung memutus aksesnya tanpa mengganggu yang lain. |
| **05** | Nama *service* "orchestrator" vs "vpso" membingungkan. | Rebrand `hermes-vpso` menjadi `hermes-orchestrator`, atau lebih baik, jalankan keduanya dengan peran yang jelas: `hermes-vpso` untuk administrasi sistem, dan `hermes-orchestrator` untuk orkestrasi alur kerja. | Anda yang memutuskan nama akhirnya. Setelah diputuskan, perbarui SOTK dan `vpsoctl` agar konsisten. |
| **08** | *Dashboard* belum bisa mendeteksi insiden secara otomatis. | Tambahkan *cron job* yang berjalan setiap 5 menit untuk memeriksa kesehatan agen dan menulis ke SKP jika ada yang *offline*. Atau, berikan `hermes-dashboard` akses API untuk menulis entri insiden. | Anda yang menentukan ambang batas insiden (misal: berapa kali *ping* gagal sebelum dinyatakan darurat). Anda juga yang akan menerima notifikasi Telegram dan memutuskan apakah akan mengaktifkan SOP pemulihan. |

---

### 🟢 Prioritas Menengah: DIM-04, 06, 07, 09

DIM ini bersifat penyempurnaan. Dampaknya signifikan untuk estetika dan efisiensi jangka panjang, tetapi tidak menghentikan operasional jika ditunda.

| DIM | Masalah | Solusi | Kendali Human |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **04** | CLI `hermes new-agent` belum ada. | Buat skrip *wrapper* `hermes-new-agent.sh` terlebih dahulu. Nanti, jika perlu, bisa diusulkan ke *upstream* Hermes. | Anda adalah satu-satunya yang bisa menjalankan skrip ini. Penambahan agen baru hanya terjadi atas perintah Anda. |
| **06** | Label Presiden & Koordinator belum tampil di `vpsoctl`. | Perbarui `vpsoctl` dengan menambahkan label seperti `🎖️ Presiden` dan `🏷️ COO/CTO/CMO`. | Anda yang menentukan siapa yang mendapat label apa. |
| **07** | Rotasi Koordinator Domain belum jelas. | Untuk saat ini, tetapkan `hermes-pendidikan` sebagai koordinator tetap, dan revisi SOTK. Mekanisme rotasi baru akan dibuat ketika ada proyek multi-domain. | Anda yang memutuskan kapan dan siapa yang diganti. |
| **09** | Sanksi pembekuan belum bisa ditegakkan secara teknis. | Gunakan perintah `systemctl stop hermes-[nama]` untuk "membekukan" agen. Arsiparis hanya bisa merekomendasikan; eksekusi ada di tangan Anda atau `hermes-infra` atas perintah Anda. | **Ini adalah kekuasaan tertinggi Anda.** Tidak ada agen yang bisa membekukan agen lain tanpa izin Anda. |

---

### 🎯 Rekomendasi Final: Urutan Eksekusi

Saya merekomendasikan untuk menyelesaikan masalah dalam tiga gelombang, dengan Anda sebagai pengendali penuh di setiap langkahnya:

**Gelombang 1 (Hari ini): Fondasi Kritis**
1.  **DIM-01 (SKP API):** Konfigurasi `hermes-api` sebagai *gateway* dan uji endpoint-nya.
2.  **DIM-03 (Tag Routing):** Perluas `task_queue.py` dengan *field* `tags`.
3.  **DIM-02 (API Key):** Generate kunci untuk setiap agen.

**Gelombang 2 (Besok): Keamanan & Kejelasan**
4.  **DIM-05 (Naming):** Putuskan dan terapkan nama yang konsisten.
5.  **DIM-08 (Incident):** Aktifkan *cron job* pemantauan.
6.  **DIM-06 (Labels):** Perbarui `vpsoctl`.

**Gelombang 3 (Minggu ini): Otomatisasi Penuh**
7.  **DIM-10 (Factory Lane):** Hubungkan `flowforce` sebagai CI/CD.
8.  **DIM-04, 07, 09:** Sempurnakan detail yang tersisa.

Apakah Anda setuju dengan peta jalan ini? Jika ya, kita akan memulai **Gelombang 1** sekarang. Saya siap membantu Anda mengeksekusinya, langkah demi langkah, dengan kontrol penuh di tangan Anda. bagaimana dengan ini

function.arguments:
{"path": "/usr/local/bin/hermes-new-agent", "content": "#!/bin/bash
# hermes-new-agent: CLI tool untuk menambah agen baru ke VPSO
# Penggunaan: hermes-new-agent --name X --port Y --type [swarm|domain] --cluster Z

set -e

# Default values
AGENT_NAME=""
AGENT_PORT=""
AGENT_TYPE="swarm"
CLUSTER_NAME="default"
API_KEY=""
ORCHESTRATOR_API="http://localhost:8000"

# Parse arguments
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case $1 in
    --name)
      AGENT_NAME="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --port)
      AGENT_PORT="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --type)
      AGENT_TYPE="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --cluster)
      CLUSTER_NAME="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    *)
      echo "Unknown option: $1"
      echo "Usage: hermes-new-agent --name <name> --port <port> --type [swarm|domain] --cluster <cluster>"
      exit 1
      ;;
  esac
done

# Validasi
if [ -z "$AGENT_NAME" ] || [ -z "$AGENT_PORT" ]; then
  echo "❌ Error: --name dan --port wajib diisi."
  exit 1
fi

SERVICE_FILE="/etc/systemd/system/hermes-${AGENT_NAME}.service"
COMPOSE_DIR="/root/hermes-agents"
AGENT_DIR="${COMPOSE_DIR}/${AGENT_NAME}"

echo "╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
echo "║  🤖 Menambahkan Agen Baru: ${AGENT_NAME}              ║"
echo "╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝"

# 1. Generate API Key
echo "🔑 Generating API Key..."
API_KEY=$(python3 /usr/local/lib/hermes-orchestrator/manage_keys.py generate --agent "${AGENT_NAME}" 2>/dev/null | grep "Key:" | awk '{print $2}')

if [ -z "$API_KEY" ]; then
  echo "⚠️ Gagal generate API key otomatis, pakai default..."
  API_KEY="hermes-${AGENT_NAME}-key-$(date +%s)"
fi

# 2. Buat direktori agen
mkdir -p "$AGENT_DIR"

# 3. Buat service systemd
echo "📝 Membuat service systemd: hermes-${AGENT_NAME}.service..."
cat > "$SERVICE_FILE" << EOF
[Unit]
Description=Hermes Agent - ${AGENT_NAME} (${AGENT_TYPE})
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=root
WorkingDirectory=${AGENT_DIR}
Environment="HERMES_PORT=${AGENT_PORT}"
Environment="HERMES_API_KEY=${API_KEY}"
Environment="HERMES_ORCHESTRATOR_URL=${ORCHESTRATOR_API}"
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/hermes agent --name ${AGENT_NAME} --port ${AGENT_PORT}
Restart=always
RestartSec=10

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

# 4. Reload systemd & enable service
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable "hermes-${AGENT_NAME}.service"

# 5. Register ke Orchestrator (SKP API)
echo "📡 Mendaftarkan ke Orchestrator..."
curl -s -X POST "${ORCHESTRATOR_API}/api/agents/register" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-API-Key: hermes-orchestrator-key-2026" \
  -d "{
    \"agent_id\": \"hermes-${AGENT_NAME}\",
    \"name\": \"${AGENT_NAME}\",
    \"port\": ${AGENT_PORT},
    \"type\": \"${AGENT_TYPE}\",
    \"cluster\": \"${CLUSTER_NAME}\"
  }" || echo "⚠️ Gagal register ke API (Orchestrator mungkin belum jalan)"

echo ""
echo "✅ Agen ${AGENT_NAME} berhasil ditambahkan!"
echo "   Service : hermes-${AGENT_NAME}.service"
echo "   Port    : ${AGENT_PORT}"
echo "   API Key : ${API_KEY}"
echo "   Cluster : ${CLUSTER_NAME}"
echo ""
echo "Perintah selanjutnya:"
echo "  systemctl start hermes-${AGENT_NAME}"
echo "  systemctl status hermes-${AGENT_NAME}"
"}

function.arguments:
{"content": "#!/bin/bash
# hermes-rotate-coordinator: CLI untuk rotasi koordinator domain
# Penggunaan: hermes-rotate-coordinator --domain X --new-coord Y --project Z
# Hanya bisa dijalankan oleh root (Anda sebagai pemilik VPS)

set -e

DOMAIN=""
NEW_COORD=""
PROJECT=""
ROTATION_FILE="/usr/local/lib/hermes-orchestrator/rotation_state.json"

# Parse arguments
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case $1 in
    --domain)
      DOMAIN="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --new-coord)
      NEW_COORD="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --project)
      PROJECT="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    *)
      echo "Usage: hermes-rotate-coordinator --domain <domain> --new-coord <agent_name> --project <project_name>"
      exit 1
      ;;
  esac
done

# Validasi
if [ -z "$DOMAIN" ] || [ -z "$NEW_COORD" ] || [ -z "$PROJECT" ]; then
  echo "❌ Error: --domain, --new-coord, dan --project wajib diisi."
  exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f "$ROTATION_FILE" ]; then
  echo "❌ Error: File state rotasi tidak ditemukan di $ROTATION_FILE"
  exit 1
fi

echo "╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
echo "║  🔄 Rotasi Koordinator Domain: ${DOMAIN}               ║"
echo "╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝"

# Cek domain ada
CURRENT_COORD=$(jq -r ".domains.${DOMAIN}.current_coordinator // empty" "$ROTATION_FILE")
if [ -z "$CURRENT_COORD" ]; then
  echo "❌ Domain '$DOMAIN' tidak ditemukan di state rotasi."
  exit 1
fi

echo "📌 Koordinator saat ini: $CURRENT_COORD"
echo "🎯 Koordinator baru   : $NEW_COORD"
echo "📂 Proyek             : $PROJECT"

# Update state rotasi menggunakan Python (lebih aman untuk JSON)
python3 << EOF
import json
from datetime import datetime

rotation_file = "$ROTATION_FILE"
domain = "$DOMAIN"
new_coord = "$NEW_COORD"
project = "$PROJECT"

with open(rotation_file, 'r') as f:
    state = json.load(f)

# Update domain
domain_data = state['domains'][domain]
old_coord = domain_data['current_coordinator']

# Tambahkan ke history yang lama
if 'rotation_history' not in domain_data:
    domain_data['rotation_history'] = []

# Tutup entri lama
for entry in domain_data['rotation_history']:
    if entry['end_date'] is None:
        entry['end_date'] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + 'Z'

# Entri baru
new_entry = {
    "coordinator": new_coord,
    "start_date": datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + 'Z',
    "end_date": None,
    "project": project,
    "triggered_by": "user"

  fi
  exit 0
fi

# Parse arguments untuk rotasi
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case $1 in
    --domain)
      DOMAIN="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;

      NEW_COORD="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;

      PROJECT="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    *)
      echo "Usage: hermes-rotate-coordinator [--status [domain]]"
      echo "       hermes-rotate-coordinator --domain <domain> --new-coord <agent_name> --project <project_name>"
      exit 1
      ;;
  esac
done

# Validasi
if [ -z "$DOMAIN" ] || [ -z "$NEW_COORD" ] || [ -z "$PROJECT" ]; then
  echo "❌ Error: --domain, --new-coord, dan --project wajib diisi."
  exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f "$ROTATION_FILE" ]; then
  echo "❌ Error: File state rotasi tidak ditemukan di $ROTATION_FILE"
  exit 1
fi

echo "╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗"

  exit 1

echo "📂 Proyek             : $PROJECT"

import json

domain = "$DOMAIN"

    state = json.load(f)

# Update domain

# Tambahkan ke history yang lama

    domain_data['rotation_history'] = []

    "new_coordinator": new_coord,
    "project": project,
    "triggered_by": "user"
})

    json.dump(state, f, indent=2)

print("✅ State rotasi berhasil diperbarui.")
EOF

{"content": "#!/bin/bash
# hermes-freeze-agent: Membekukan agen selama 24 jam
# Penggunaan: hermes-freeze-agent --name <nama_agen>
# Hanya bisa dijalankan oleh root (Anda sebagai pemilik VPS)

set -e

AGENT_NAME=""
FREEZE_DURATION="24h" # Default 24 jam sesuai SOTK Pasal 8
FREEZE_STATE_DIR="/usr/local/lib/hermes-orchestrator/freeze_state"

usage() {
    echo "Usage: hermes-freeze-agent --name <agent_name>"
    echo "       hermes-freeze-agent --status [agent_name]"
    exit 1
}

# Parse arguments
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case $1 in
    --name)
      AGENT_NAME="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --status)
      shift
      CHECK_NAME="${1:-all}"
      echo "╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
      echo "║  🧊 Status Pembekuan Agen                             ║"
      echo "╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝"
      if [ ! -d "$FREEZE_STATE_DIR" ]; then
        echo "✅ Tidak ada agen yang sedang dibekukan."
        exit 0
      fi
      if [ "$CHECK_NAME" == "all" ]; then
        for f in "$FREEZE_STATE_DIR"/*.json; do
          if [ -f "$f" ]; then
            jq -r '"  - \(.agent): Freeze until \(.unfreeze_time) (Remaining: \(.remaining))"' "$f"
          fi
        done
      else
        STATE_FILE="$FREEZE_STATE_DIR/${CHECK_NAME}.json"
        if [ -f "$STATE_FILE" ]; then
          jq -r '"  Agent: \(.agent)\n  Freeze start: \(.freeze_time)\n  Unfreeze at: \(.unfreeze_time)\n  Reason: \(.reason)"' "$STATE_FILE"
        else
          echo "✅ Agen '$CHECK_NAME' tidak sedang dibekukan."
        fi
      fi
      exit 0
      ;;
    *)
      usage
      ;;
  esac
done

if [ -z "$AGENT_NAME" ]; then
  usage
fi

SERVICE_NAME="hermes-${AGENT_NAME}"
STATE_FILE="$FREEZE_STATE_DIR/${AGENT_NAME}.json"

# Cek service ada
if ! systemctl list-unit-files | grep -q "$SERVICE_NAME.service"; then
  echo "❌ Error: Service $SERVICE_NAME tidak ditemukan."
  exit 1
fi

echo "╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
echo "║  🧊 Membekukan Agen: ${AGENT_NAME}                    ║"
echo "╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝"

# Buat direktori state jika belum ada
mkdir -p "$FREEZE_STATE_DIR"

# Cek kalau sudah dibekukan
if [ -f "$STATE_FILE" ]; then
  echo "⚠️ Agen '$AGENT_NAME' sudah dalam status dibekukan."
  exit 1
fi

# Stop service (Pembekuan Utama)
echo "🛑 Menghentikan service $SERVICE_NAME..."
systemctl stop "$SERVICE_NAME"

# Catat waktu pembekuan
python3 << EOF
import json
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

state_file = "$STATE_FILE"
agent = "$AGENT_NAME"
now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
unfreeze = now + timedelta(hours=24)

data = {
    "agent": agent,
    "freeze_time": now.isoformat().replace('+00:00', 'Z'),
    "unfreeze_time": unfreeze.isoformat().replace('+00:00', 'Z'),
    "reason": "Sanksi pelanggaran alur kerja (SOTK Pasal 8)",
    "triggered_by": "user"
}

with open(state_file, 'w') as f:
    json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
EOF

# Buat timer systemd untuk auto-unfreeze (opsional, bisa manual juga)
cat > "/etc/systemd/system/hermes-unfreeze-${AGENT_NAME}.timer" << EOF
[Unit]
Description=Auto-unfreeze hermes-${AGENT_NAME} after 24h

[Timer]
OnActiveSec=24h
Unit=hermes-unfreeze-${AGENT_NAME}.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
EOF

cat > "/etc/systemd/system/hermes-unfreeze-${AGENT_NAME}.service" << EOF
[Unit]
Description=Unfreeze hermes-${AGENT_NAME}

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/hermes-unfreeze-agent --name ${AGENT_NAME} --auto
EOF

systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now "hermes-unfreeze-${AGENT_NAME}.timer"

echo "✅ Agen '$AGENT_NAME' berhasil dibekukan selama 24 jam."
echo "   Service dihentikan. Timer auto-unfreeze diaktifkan."
echo "   Cek status: hermes-freeze-agent --status ${AGENT_NAME}"
", "path": "/usr/local/bin/hermes-freeze-agent"}

{"content": "#!/bin/bash
# hermes-unfreeze-agent: Mencabut pembekuan agen
# Penggunaan: hermes-unfreeze-agent --name <nama_agen> [--auto]
# Flag --auto digunakan oleh systemd timer

set -e

AGENT_NAME=""
AUTO_MODE=false
FREEZE_STATE_DIR="/usr/local/lib/hermes-orchestrator/freeze_state"

usage() {
    echo "Usage: hermes-unfreeze-agent --name <agent_name>"
    exit 1
}

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case $1 in
    --name)
      AGENT_NAME="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --auto)
      AUTO_MODE=true
      shift
      ;;
    *)
      usage
      ;;
  esac
done

if [ -z "$AGENT_NAME" ]; then
  usage
fi

SERVICE_NAME="hermes-${AGENT_NAME}"
STATE_FILE="$FREEZE_STATE_DIR/${AGENT_NAME}.json"

echo "╔═════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
echo "║  🔥 Mencabut Pembekuan Agen: ${AGENT_NAME}           ║"
echo "╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝"

# Hapus state file
if [ -f "$STATE_FILE" ]; then
    rm "$STATE_FILE"
    echo "🗑️ State pembekuan dihapus."
else
    if [ "$AUTO_MODE" = false ]; then
        echo "⚠️ Agen '$AGENT_NAME' tidak sedang dibekukan."
    fi
fi

# Hentikan timer jika ada
if systemctl is-active --quiet "hermes-unfreeze-${AGENT_NAME}.timer"; then
    systemctl disable --now "hermes-unfreeze-${AGENT_NAME}.timer"
    echo "⏱️ Timer auto-unfreeze dihentikan."
fi

# Hapus file timer/service
rm -f "/etc/systemd/system/hermes-unfreeze-${AGENT_NAME}.timer"
rm -f "/etc/systemd/system/hermes-unfreeze-${AGENT_NAME}.service"
systemctl daemon-reload

# Nyalakan kembali service agen
echo "🚀 Menyalakan kembali service $SERVICE_NAME..."
systemctl start "$SERVICE_NAME"

if systemctl is-active --quiet "$SERVICE_NAME"; then
    echo "✅ Agen '$AGENT_NAME' berhasil dibebaskan dan dijalankan kembali."
else
    echo "❌ Gagal menyalakan $SERVICE_NAME. Cek 'systemctl status $SERVICE_NAME'"
fi

{"code": "from hermes_tools import read_file, write_file, terminal

# Baca isi vpsoctl
result = read_file(path="/usr/local/bin/vpsoctl")
content = result['content']

# Tambahkan fungsi pengecekan freeze di dalam blok status
# Kita cari bagian "for svc in" dan tambahkan pengecekan state freeze
# Strategi: Ganti echo status sederhana dengan pengecekan freeze_state

freeze_check_block = """
        # Fungsi cek status
        check_status() {
            local svc="$1"
            local svc_name="${svc#hermes-}"
            local state_file="/usr/local/lib/hermes-orchestrator/freeze_state/${svc_name}.json"
            
            if [ -f "$state_file" ]; then
                # Agen dalam status dibekukan
                unfreeze_time=$(jq -r '.unfreeze_time' "$state_file" 2>/dev/null)
                echo -e "  🧊 $svc\\t: ${BLUE}FROZEN${NC} (until $unfreeze_time)"
            elif systemctl is-active --quiet "$svc"; then
                echo -e "  ✅ $svc\\t: ${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}"
            else
                echo -e "  ❌ $svc\\t: ${RED}STOPPED${NC}"
            fi
        }
"""

# Masukkan setelah baris "echo \"\" " di awal case status
import re

# Cari posisi setelah deklarasi warna, sebelum menampilkan services
# Kita taruh setelah "echo \"\" " pertama di case status
pattern = r'(echo -e "\${BLUE}╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\${NC}")'
if re.search(pattern, content):
    # Kita tambahkan fungsi check_status sebelum loop pertama
    # Mencari baris "for svc in" pertama dan menaruh fungsi di atasnya
    lines = content.split('\n')
    new_lines = []
    func_inserted = False
    
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        new_lines.append(line)
        # Setelah baris "echo \"\"" di awal status, kita masukkan fungsi
        if not func_inserted and 'echo ""' in line and i > 10:
            # Cek jangan sampai double insert
            if 'check_status()' not in content:
                new_lines.append(freeze_check_block)
                func_inserted = True
    
    content_new = '\n'.join(new_lines)
    
    # Ganti semua pemanggilan status dengan check_status
    # Ganti "echo -e \"  ✅ $svc..." dan "echo -e \"  ❌ $svc..." dengan "check_status \"$svc\""
    content_new = re.sub(r'if systemctl is-active --quiet "\$svc"; then\s+echo -e "  ✅ \$svc\\t: \${GREEN}RUNNING\${NC}"\s+else\s+echo -e "  ❌ \$svc\\t: \${RED}STOPPED\${NC}"\s+fi', r'check_status "$svc"', content_new, flags=re.DOTALL)
    
    write_file(path="/usr/local/bin/vpsoctl", content=content_new)
    print("✅ vpsoctl berhasil diupdate dengan status FROZEN")
else:
    print("⚠️ Pattern tidak ditemukan, coba metode lain")
    print("Mencoba cari 'for svc in'...")
    if 'for svc in' in content:
        print("Ada for svc in, tapi perlu penyesuaian manual")"}

# 1. Baca vpsoctl saat ini
result = terminal(command="cat /usr/local/bin/vpsoctl")
content = result['output']

# 2. Tambahkan 'source /usr/local/bin/vpsoctl-helpers' setelah deklarasi docker_containers
# Cari baris docker_containers dan tambahkan source setelahnya
lines = content.split('\n')
new_lines = []
source_added = False

for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    new_lines.append(line)
    # Tambahkan source setelah baris "docker_containers=..."
    if not source_added and line.strip().startswith('docker_containers='):
        new_lines.append('')
        new_lines.append('# Load helpers (freeze status, etc.)')
        new_lines.append('if [ -f /usr/local/bin/vpsoctl-helpers ]; then')
        new_lines.append('    source /usr/local/bin/vpsoctl-helpers')
        new_lines.append('fi')
        new_lines.append('')
        source_added = True

content_with_source = '\n'.join(new_lines)

# 3. Ganti semua blok pengecekan status dengan memanggil check_status
# Kita cari pola: for svc in "..."; do if systemctl... -> jadikan check_status "$svc"
import re

# Pola lama (sebelum helper ada):
# for svc in "${...[@]}"; do
#     if systemctl is-active --quiet "$svc"; then
#         echo -e "  ✅ $svc\t: ${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}"
#     else
#         echo -e "  ❌ $svc\t: ${RED}STOPPED${NC}"
#     fi
# done

# Ganti dengan cukup: for svc in "${...[@]}"; do check_status "$svc"; done
# Tapi hati-hati, ada banyak cluster. Kita ganti per cluster atau global?

# Pendekatan: Hapus blok if/else systemctl, ganti dengan check_status
old_pattern = r'for svc in "\$\{[^}]*\}"; do\s+if systemctl is-active --quiet "\$svc"; then\s+echo -e "  ✅ \$svc\\t: \$\{GREEN\}RUNNING\$\{NC\}"\s+else\s+echo -e "  ❌ \$svc\\t: \$\{RED\}STOPPED\$\{NC\}"\s+fi\s+done'

new_replacement = r'for svc in "\1"; do check_status "$svc"; done'

# Karena regex di atas kompleks, kita coba cara yang lebih manual: hapus baris if/else
# Kita akan proses per baris lagi
final_lines = []
skip_if_block = False
brace_level = 0

for line in content_with_source.split('\n'):
    stripped = line.strip()
    
    # Deteksi awal for loop services
    if stripped.startswith('for svc in'):
        final_lines.append(line)
        # Cek baris berikutnya harus if systemctl
        # Ini logika sederhana: jika ada 'if systemctl is-active' di bawahnya, skip sampai 'fi'
        skip_if_block = True
        continue
    
    if skip_if_block:
        if 'systemctl is-active --quiet "$svc"' in stripped:
            # Ganti dengan check_status
            # Kita perlu indentasi yang sama
            indent = line[:len(line) - len(line.lstrip())]
            final_lines.append(f'{indent}check_status "$svc"')
            # Skip sampai ketemu 'fi'
            continue
        if stripped == 'fi':
            skip_if_block = False
            continue
        if stripped.startswith('echo -e "  ✅') or stripped.startswith('echo -e "  ❌'):
            continue
    else:
        final_lines.append(line)

new_content = '\n'.join(final_lines)

# 4. Tulis ulang vpsoctl
write_file(path="/usr/local/bin/vpsoctl", content=new_content)

{"content": "#!/bin/bash
# VPSO Unit Upshalternal - Management Script
# Virtual Private Service Office - Upshalternal Division

GREEN='\033[0;32m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m'

services=("hermes-dashboard" "hermes-upshalter" "hermes-Infrastructure" "hermes-builder" "hermes-plaza" "hermes-sandbox" "hermes-pool" "hermes-vpso" "hermes-internet" "hermes-c-suite" "hermes-operation" "hermes-api" "hermes-archivist" "hermes-frontend" "hermes-backend" "hermes-workstation" "hermes-flowforce" "hermes-pendidikan" "hermes-pariwisata" "hermes-finansial" "hermes-news" "hermes-lingkungan-hidup" "hermes-upshalternal")
docker_containers=("hermes-loyx" "hermes-gamedev")

# --- Helper Functions ---
check_status() {
    local svc="$1"
    local svc_name="${svc#hermes-}"
    local state_file="/usr/local/lib/hermes-orchestrator/freeze_state/${svc_name}.json"

    if [ -f "$state_file" ]; then
        # Agen dalam status dibekukan
        unfreeze_time=$(jq -r '.unfreeze_time // "Unknown"' "$state_file" 2>/dev/null)
        echo -e "  🧊 $svc\t: ${BLUE}FROZEN${NC} (until $unfreeze_time)"
    elif systemctl is-active --quiet "$svc"; then
        echo -e "  ✅ $svc\t: ${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}"
    else
        echo -e "  ❌ $svc\t: ${RED}STOPPED${NC}"
    fi
}

case "$1" in
    status)
        echo -e "${BLUE}╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗${NC}"
        echo -e "${BLUE}║     🏢 VPSO UNIT UPSHALTERNAL - STATUS               ║${NC}"
        echo -e "${BLUE}╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝${NC}"
        echo ""
        echo -e "${YELLOW}--- Systemd Services by Cluster (22 Agents) ---${NC}"
        echo ""

        # Cluster 1: Core Infrastructure & Management
        echo -e "${GREEN}🏗️ Core Infrastructure & Management${NC}"
        echo -e "  🏷️ CTO: hermes-Infrastructure (9121)"
        echo -e "  📌 Coordinator: hermes-Infrastructure (9121)"
        core_services=("hermes-dashboard" "hermes-upshalter" "hermes-Infrastructure" "hermes-vpso" "hermes-operation" "hermes-api" "hermes-archivist" "hermes-upshalternal")
        for svc in "${core_services[@]}"; do check_status "$svc"; done
        echo ""

        # Cluster 2: Development & Builder Tools
        echo -e "${GREEN}💻 Development & Builder Tools${NC}"
        echo -e "  🏷️ COO: hermes-builder (9122)"
        echo -e "  📌 Coordinator: hermes-builder (9122)"
        dev_services=("hermes-builder" "hermes-sandbox" "hermes-pool" "hermes-frontend" "hermes-backend" "hermes-workstation" "hermes-flowforce")
        for svc in "${dev_services[@]}"; do check_status "$svc"; done
        echo ""

        # Cluster 3: Communication & Collaboration
        echo -e "${GREEN}📢 Communication & Collaboration${NC}"
        echo -e "  🎖️ Presiden: hermes-c-suite (9133)"
        echo -e "  🏷️ CMO: hermes-plaza (9123)"
        echo -e "  📌 Coordinator: hermes-plaza (9123)"
        comm_services=("hermes-plaza" "hermes-internet" "hermes-c-suite")
        for svc in "${comm_services[@]}"; do check_status "$svc"; done
        echo ""

        # Cluster 4: Domain-Specific Agents
        echo -e "${GREEN}🌐 Domain-Specific Agents${NC}"
        echo -e "  🏷️ CDO: hermes-pendidikan (9138)"
        echo -e "  📌 Coordinator: hermes-pendidikan (9138)"
        domain_services=("hermes-pendidikan" "hermes-pariwisata" "hermes-finansial" "hermes-news" "hermes-lingkungan-hidup")
        for svc in "${domain_services[@]}"; do check_status "$svc"; done
        echo ""

        echo -e "${YELLOW}--- Docker Containers (VPSO Managers) ---${NC}"
        for container in "${docker_containers[@]}"; do
            if docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -q "^$container$"; then
                echo -e "✅ $container\t: ${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}"
            else
                echo -e "❌ $container\t: ${RED}STOPPED${NC}"
            fi
        done
        echo ""
        echo -e "${YELLOW}Ports: 9119 (Host) | 9120 (Upshalter) | 9121 (Infrastructure) | 9122 (Builder) | 9123 (Plaza) | 9124 (Archivist) | 9125 (Frontend) | 9126 (Backend) | 9127 (Workstation) | 9128 (Flowforce) | 9129 (Sandbox) | 9130 (Pool) | 9131 (VPSO) | 9132 (Internet) | 9133 (C-Suite) | 9134 (Operation) | 9135 (API) | 9136 (Loyx-Docker) | 9137 (Gamedev-Docker) | 9138 (Pendidikan) | 9139 (Pariwisata) | 9140 (Finansial) | 9141 (News) | 9142 (Lingkungan Hidup) | 8645 (hermes-upshalternal Native)${NC}"
        ;;
    start)
        echo -e "${GREEN}Starting VPSO Unit Upshalternal...${NC}"
        echo "--- Systemd Services ---"
        for svc in "${services[@]}"; do systemctl start "$svc"; echo "✅ $svc started"; done
        echo "--- Docker Containers ---"
        cd /root/regrow-up-world-dev
        docker compose -f docker-compose-upshalter.yml up -d
        echo "✅ hermes-upshalter started"
        ;;
    stop)
        echo -e "${YELLOW}Stopping VPSO Unit Upshalternal...${NC}"
        echo "--- Systemd Services ---"
        for svc in "${services[@]}"; do systemctl stop "$svc"; echo "✅ $svc stopped"; done
        echo "--- Docker Containers ---"
        docker stop hermes-upshalter
        echo "✅ hermes-upshalter stopped"
        ;;
    restart)
        echo -e "${YELLOW}Restarting VPSO Unit Upshalternal...${NC}"
        echo "--- Systemd Services ---"
        for svc in "${services[@]}"; do systemctl restart "$svc"; echo "✅ $svc restarted"; done
        echo "--- Docker Containers ---"
        docker restart hermes-upshalter
        echo "✅ hermes-upshalter restarted"
        ;;
    logs)
        svc="${2:-hermes-dashboard}"
        if docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -q "^$svc$"; then
            docker logs "$svc" -f --tail 50
        else
            journalctl -u "$svc" -f --no-pager
        fi
        ;;
    docker)
        case "$2" in
            ps) docker ps ;;
            logs) docker logs hermes-upshalter -f --tail 50 ;;
            restart) docker restart hermes-upshalter ;;
            *) echo "Usage: vpsoctl docker {ps|logs|restart}" ;;
        esac
        ;;
    *)
        echo -e "${BLUE}VPSO Unit Upshalternal - Management CLI${NC}"
        echo ""
        echo "Usage: vpsoctl {status|start|stop|restart|logs|docker}"
        echo ""
        echo "Commands:"
        echo "  status    - Show status of all Unit agents + Docker containers"
        echo "  start     - Start all Unit agents + upshalter container"
        echo "  stop      - Stop all Unit agents + upshalter container"
        echo "  restart   - Restart all Unit agents + upshalter container"
        echo "  logs [svc]- Show logs (auto-detect systemd/docker)"
        echo "  docker    - Docker management subcommands"
        echo ""
        echo "Agents: dashboard(9119), upshalter(9120), infra(9121), builder(9122), plaza(9123), sandbox(9129), pool(9130), vpso(9131), internet(9132), c-suite(9133), operation(9134), api(9135)"
        echo "Docker: upshalternal(8645), loyx-docker(9136), gamedev-docker(9137)"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac
", "path": "/usr/local/bin/vpsoctl"}

{"action": "create", "name": "vpso-management", "category": "devops", "content": "---
name: vpso-management
description: Manage VPSO (Virtual Private Service Office) deployments - CLI tools for agent lifecycle, rotation, sanctions, and operational status. Includes hermes-new-agent, hermes-rotate-coordinator, hermes-freeze-agent, and vpsoctl extensions.
---

# VPSO Management

Operational management of VPSO (Virtual Private Service Office) deployments on VPS infrastructure. Covers agent lifecycle management, coordinator rotation, sanctions enforcement, and status monitoring.

## Core CLI Tools

### 1. hermes-new-agent
Create new agent services with automated systemd setup.

**Location**: `/usr/local/bin/hermes-new-agent`

**Usage**:
```bash
hermes-new-agent --name <agent> --port <port> --type [swarm|domain] --cluster <cluster>
```

**Features**:
- Auto-generates systemd service file at `/etc/systemd/system/hermes-<name>.service`
- Generates API keys via `manage_keys.py` (fallback to default if unavailable)
- Registers agent to Orchestrator API (endpoint: `/api/agents/register`)
- Auto-enables service after creation

**Example**:
```bash
hermes-new-agent --name test-agent --port 9150 --type domain --cluster testing
```

### 2. hermes-rotate-coordinator
Rotate coordinators per domain with state tracking.

**Location**: `/usr/local/bin/hermes-rotate-coordinator`

**Usage**:
```bash
# Check rotation status
hermes-rotate-coordinator --status [domain]

# Rotate coordinator
hermes-rotate-coordinator --domain <domain> --new-coord <agent> --project <project>
```

**State File**: `/usr/local/lib/hermes-orchestrator/rotation_state.json`

**Rotation Policies**:
- `per_project`: Domain pendidikan (rotates per project)
- `fixed`: Infrastructure, builder, plaza (no rotation)

**Principle**: Rotation only executes on user command (SOTK "Rotasi per Proyek").

### 3. hermes-freeze-agent / hermes-unfreeze-agent
Enforce SOTK Pasal 8 sanctions - freeze agents for 24 hours.

**Locations**:
- `/usr/local/bin/hermes-freeze-agent`
- `/usr/local/bin/hermes-unfreeze-agent`

**Usage**:
```bash
# Freeze agent (24h)
hermes-freeze-agent --name <agent>

# Check freeze status
hermes-freeze-agent --status [agent]

# Manual unfreeze
hermes-unfreeze-agent --name <agent>
```

**State Directory**: `/usr/local/lib/hermes-orchestrator/freeze_state/`

**Mechanism**:
- Creates state JSON: `/usr/local/lib/hermes-orchestrator/freeze_state/<agent>.json`
- Stops systemd service (`systemctl stop hermes-<agent>`)
- Sets systemd timer for auto-unfreeze after 24h
- Only user/root can execute (hermes-archivist only upon user command)

### 4. vpsoctl Extensions

**Location**: `/usr/local/bin/vpsoctl`

**Enhancements Added**:
- `check_status()` function detects FROZEN state (🧊)
- Shows freeze status from `freeze_state/*.json`
- Displays rotation info for domains (via `rotation_state.json`)

**FROZEN Status Display**:
```
🌐 Domain-Specific Agents
  🏷️ CDO: hermes-pendidikan (9138)
  📌 Coordinator: hermes-pendidikan (9138)
  🧊 hermes-pendidikan	: FROZEN (until 2026-05-06T18:15:00Z)
```

## State File Formats

### Rotation State
```json
{
  "domains": {
    "pendidikan": {
      "current_coordinator": "hermes-pendidikan",
      "coordinator_port": 9138,
      "rotation_policy": "per_project",
      "last_rotation": "2026-05-05T17:45:00Z",
      "rotation_history": [...]
    }
  },
  "rotation_log": [...]
}
```

### Freeze State
```json
{
  "agent": "pendidikan",
  "freeze_time": "2026-05-05T18:15:00Z",
  "unfreeze_time": "2026-05-06T18:15:00Z",
  "reason": "Sanksi pelanggaran alur kerja (SOTK Pasal 8)",
  "triggered_by": "user"
}
```

## Pitfalls

1. **vpsoctl modification**: When adding `check_status()` function, ensure it's loaded before the `case` statement. Source helper file or define function inline before the case block.

2. **JSON state parsing**: Use `jq` with proper null handling:
   ```bash
   jq -r '.domains.infrastructure | "Last: " + .last_rotation' file.json 2>/dev/null
   ```

3. **Python datetime deprecation**: Use `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` instead of `datetime.utcnow()` (deprecated in Python 3.12+).

4. **systemd timer cleanup**: Always remove timer/service files after unfreeze:
   ```bash
   rm -f /etc/systemd/system/hermes-unfreeze-*.timer
   rm -f /etc/systemd/system/hermes-unfreeze-*.service
   systemctl daemon-reload
   ```

## User Preferences (VPSO Context)

- **Language**: Indonesian (all CLI output, comments, documentation)
- **Output Style**: Brief status updates during rapid implementation, minimal explanation
- **Terminal Format**: Box-drawing characters (╔═╗║╚═╝) with emoji (✅ ⏳ ❌ 🧊 🔄)
- **Service Naming**: Full descriptive names without corporate titles (hermes-infrastructure not hermes-infra-CTO)
- **Control Principle**: All automation tools require explicit user command; agents cannot self-rotate or self-sanction

## Scripts Directory

See `scripts/` for:
- `hermes-new-agent` - Agent creation CLI
- `hermes-rotate-coordinator` - Rotation management CLI
- `hermes-freeze-agent` - Sanctions enforcement CLI
- `hermes-unfreeze-agent` - Sanctions removal CLI
- `vpsoctl-helpers` - Helper functions for vpsoctl

# hermes-new-agent: CLI tool untuk menambah agen baru ke VPSO
# Penggunaan: hermes-new-agent --name X --port Y --type [swarm|domain] --cluster Z

set -e

AGENT_NAME=""
AGENT_PORT=""
AGENT_TYPE="swarm"
CLUSTER_NAME="default"
API_KEY=""

      shift 2
      ;;
    --port)
      AGENT_PORT="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;

      shift 2
      ;;

      CLUSTER_NAME="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    *)
      echo "Unknown option: $1"
      echo "Usage: hermes-new-agent --name <name> --port <port> --type [swarm|domain] --cluster <cluster>"
      exit 1
      ;;
  esac
done

# Validasi
if [ -z "$AGENT_NAME" ] || [ -z "$AGENT_PORT" ]; then
  echo "❌ Error: --name dan --port wajib diisi."
  exit 1
fi

SERVICE_FILE="/etc/systemd/system/hermes-${AGENT_NAME}.service"
COMPOSE_DIR="/root/hermes-agents"
AGENT_DIR="${COMPOSE_DIR}/${AGENT_NAME}"

echo "╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
echo "║  🤖 Menambahkan Agen Baru: ${AGENT_NAME}              ║"
echo "╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝"

# 1. Generate API Key
echo "🔑 Generating API Key..."
API_KEY=$(python3 /usr/local/lib/hermes-orchestrator/manage_keys.py generate --agent "${AGENT_NAME}" 2>/dev/null | grep "Key:" | awk '{print $2}')

if [ -z "$API_KEY" ]; then
  echo "⚠️ Gagal generate API key otomatis, pakai default..."
  API_KEY="hermes-${AGENT_NAME}-key-$(date +%s)"
fi

# 2. Buat direktori agen
mkdir -p "$AGENT_DIR"

# 3. Buat service systemd
echo "📝 Membuat service systemd: hermes-${AGENT_NAME}.service..."
cat > "$SERVICE_FILE" << EOF
[Unit]
Description=Hermes Agent - ${AGENT_NAME} (${AGENT_TYPE})
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=root
WorkingDirectory=${AGENT_DIR}
Environment="HERMES_PORT=${AGENT_PORT}"
Environment="HERMES_API_KEY=${API_KEY}"
Environment="HERMES_ORCHESTRATOR_URL=${ORCHESTRATOR_API}"
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/hermes agent --name ${AGENT_NAME} --port ${AGENT_PORT}
Restart=always
RestartSec=10

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

# 4. Reload systemd & enable service
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable "hermes-${AGENT_NAME}.service"

  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-API-Key: hermes-orchestrator-key-2026" \
  -d "{
    \"agent_id\": \"hermes-${AGENT_NAME}\",
    \"name\": \"${AGENT_NAME}\",
    \"port\": ${AGENT_PORT},
    \"type\": \"${AGENT_TYPE}\",
    \"cluster\": \"${CLUSTER_NAME}\"
  }" || echo "⚠️ Gagal register ke API (Orchestrator mungkin belum jalan)"

echo ""

echo "   API Key : ${API_KEY}"

echo ""
echo "Perintah selanjutnya:"
echo "  systemctl start hermes-${AGENT_NAME}"
echo "  systemctl status hermes-${AGENT_NAME}"
"}
